prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, three-quarter-length demi statue portrait, 6-band horizontal multi-material body, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh tips right at the knee, where the leg would bend, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman in banba makeup — a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and lime paint strokes across the cheekbones, rhinestone and star stickers clustered on the cheeks and forehead only, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, long teased neon-pink and lime hair, a fierce, playful expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a big silver hoop with a small pearl drop.

Physique: A colossal rounded chest, an enormous belly of massive rounded folds hanging low and heavy, no waist at all, left arm crystal, right arm stone, torso/hip/thigh-stubs in 6 stepped horizontal bands.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent clear sea-blue aquamarine crystal, never hollow. Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved solid polished black obsidian with faint internal swirls, completely opaque, completely opaque.

Torso, hips and both thigh-stubs (excluding arms): 6 equal horizontal bands, stacked top to bottom, each with a raised stepped edge and shadow at its border, no gaps, no skin. Band 1 (torso/hip band 1): clear topaz-gold water with drifting light. Band 2 (torso/hip band 2): solid transparent golden-yellow citrine crystal. Band 3 (torso/hip band 3): solid transparent deep blue sapphire crystal. Band 4 (torso/hip band 4): solid transparent deep ruby-red cast glass. Band 5 (torso/hip band 5): solid transparent clear sea-blue aquamarine crystal. Band 6 (both thigh-stubs, right at the knee, where the leg would bend): solid transparent deep cobalt-blue cast glass, rounding off at both tips.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a soft lavender on one side and a warm coral on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so lavender light glances off one side and coral light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
